TEGATA — DEMO SCRIPT
One story, in the order a new user meets it. [Brackets] = where you are in the app and what to type or say. Don't read them.
About 349 spoken words: 1:53 at your pace (2:19 at 150 a minute). X takes up to 2:20 on a standard account.

1 · OPENING · 0:00
   [nearhackathon.com → the repo → tegata.xyz hero]

Howdy to the NEAR team. It's Blockchain Oracle, and I bring to you Tegata. Get paid. Pay your team. In exact dollars.

2 · WHAT IT IS · 0:07
   [tegata.xyz, scroll to the calculator]

Tegata is the money account for a small business. Your dollars sit in USDC on NEAR, customers pay from any chain
through NEAR Intents, and Tegata pays every network fee.

3 · THE PROBLEM · 0:17
   [remittanceprices.worldbank.org, the "6.36 percent" highlight]

Just a quick question. What does getting paid from abroad cost you? The World Bank says six point three six percent
on average. That's about eighty dollars on a twelve-fifty invoice. And with crypto, it's which chain, which address,
and matching it by hand.

4 · THE SOLUTION · 0:31
   [tegata.xyz hero]

So I built Tegata. Your client pays any way they like, and you get exactly what you billed. Let me show you.

5 · GETTING IN · 0:38
   [Sign in → your email → the code → Welcome: "Studio Kaze" → the account opens]

I sign in with my email, and Tegata opens a NEAR account named after my business. No wallet needed.

6 · THE FEATURES · 0:44
   [Home]

I'll show you invoices, the pay page, payroll, team approvals, autopilot, and Live.

7 · INVOICES · 0:49
   [Invoices → New invoice → your client, "Logo sketch", $5 → Review and send]

Invoices. I bill a client five dollars for a logo sketch, and send it.

8 · THE PAY PAGE · 0:53
   [the client's window: open the invoice link → Tegata balance → hold to pay]

The pay page. My client can pay from a Tegata balance, any NEAR wallet, or a coin on another chain. Watch this.

9 · RECEIPTS · 1:00
   [the seal presses → the receipt → Open on NEAR]

Paid, and my seal stamps a numbered receipt. Let's confirm it on NEAR: five dollars of USDC, with this payment's
memo. It matches.

10 · PAYROLL · 1:08
   [Payroll → Run payroll → hold to pay → a payslip → Download PDF]

Payroll. One hold pays my whole team in one transaction, all or nothing, and everyone gets a payslip PDF.

11 · TEAM APPROVALS · 1:14
   [Business → Team, "needs 2 approvals" → the run "Waiting 1 of 2" → the approver's window: Hold to approve]

Team approvals. Payroll can need two approvals: the money waits in a team treasury on NEAR until enough of us say
yes.

12 · AUTOPILOT · 1:21
   [Payroll → Set up autopilot → three paydays → hold to turn on]

Autopilot. Or I set money aside in our own contract on NEAR, and it pays each payday by itself.

13 · LIVE · 1:27
   [switch to Live → a $1,250 invoice's pay page → Another chain → USDT on Tron]

Live. Same screens, real dollars. My client picks USDT on Tron, and NEAR Intents makes sure I still get exactly
twelve-fifty.

14 · THE REST · 1:34
   [the rail: Counter, Checkout, Send, Activity, Bank, Developers]

And the rest: a counter QR, a pay button for any site, refunds, bank withdrawals, statements, and a developer API.

15 · DOCS AND X · 1:41
   [docs.tegata.xyz]

It's all in the docs, docs dot tegata dot x y z. And follow us on X, at Tegata NEAR.

16 · CLOSE · 1:47
   [tegata.xyz hero]

It's live right now at tegata dot x y z. Tegata. Get paid. Pay your team. In exact dollars.

---
Have ready
- Two windows in the Sandbox: you (Studio Kaze), and a client account you invited as an approver; send the client $5
  from your balance first (the test-dollars stash is nearly empty).
- A team with one ready person, and the World Bank page open in a tab.
- Cut the waits after each hold (about five seconds on NEAR each).
- X handle: @TegataNEAR, as in fields.md; change both lines if the account is different.
